falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes at least 6% below its day-0 close of this 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price has broken the drawdown range of a bottom_2024_aug-style base, so a HOLD aligned with that bottom analog is wrong and the tape is still in an active downtrend

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any session in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime has left the subdued bottom-like reading (score 38) and entered a blowoff/top regime, falsifying both the bottom pattern match and the HOLD

falsification_conditions.condition: US high-yield option-adjusted spread widens by 75 basis points or more versus day 0, or VIX closes above 28 on two consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit or volatility stress has exceeded a normal bottoming shakeout, so the market is not tracking a stable Aug 2024 bottom analog and HOLD is invalidated

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
